register module.summary: Create a Module, or update its name with an existing ID.
options: Stable Module ID to create or update; omitted generates a new ID.

register feature.summary: Create or update a Feature and its Module ownership.
options: Required for new Features; omitted on update retains ownership.
Stable Feature ID to create or update; omitted generates a new ID.

register artifact.usage: register artifact PATH [--kind TYPE] [--module MODULE_ID] [--feature FEATURE_ID]...
register artifact.summary: Register identity and write ownership to the document at PATH and the Registry.
register artifact.details: Specify a project path. Relative paths start at the project root.
options: Artifact kind; defaults to the existing kind, otherwise core:document.
Replace ownership with this Module and supplied Features; omit to retain ownership.
Repeat for each Feature; requires --module in the same command.

locate.summary: Return only the target public view; only Artifacts have a path.
locate.details: data: Module id/kind/name; Feature also moduleId; Artifact id/kind/title/moduleId?/featureIds/path. No related documents are expanded. Unregistered ID or missing body: invalid_reference; duplicate body: identity_conflict.

list.summary: List public entity views without resolving document paths.
list.details: data.items contains id/kind and name or title with ownership fields. No path or internal locator fields are returned; missing bodies do not block listing.
options: Filter by module, feature, artifact or an Artifact kind.

related.summary: Return one-hop neighbors in items and matched edges in relations.
related.details: data contains only items and relations. Items use the locate view, including Artifact paths; relations contain kind/from/to/source. Module documents require related MODULE_ID; Feature queries do not expand them. Only selected neighbors are located. Unregistered ID or missing body: invalid_reference; duplicate body: identity_conflict.

relate.summary: Add an extra relation between IDs, such as core:supersedes. Ownership uses register feature/artifact.
options: Remove the declared relation instead of adding it.

validate.summary: Check identities, ownership, document references and extra relations. Missing Registry is valid.
